name: Oil (Brent)
summary: Brent near $95.5 on 16 Nov, up 4.4% on the week; Iran claims tanker mine strikes near Hormuz on 15 Nov
state: Brent was near $95.5 early on 16 Nov, 4.4% higher on the week but 12.8% lower over a month, inside the $85–110 Watch band and 19% below its 52-week high of $118 (Yahoo Finance). Iran's Revolutionary Guards said on 15 Nov that two tankers hit mines in the southern Strait of Hormuz and one supertanker sank, claims not independently confirmed (Middle East Eye). No new outage above 2 mb/d was confirmed.
for_you: Oil near $95 keeps fuel, heating and transport costs elevated; further Gulf shipping incidents tend to push prices up quickly.

sources.title: Middle East Eye — Two oil tankers ablaze after striking naval mines in the Strait of Hormuz

why: Oil feeds inflation, transport and household budgets; price spikes have preceded most post-war recessions.
drivers: OPEC+ output, Middle East supply risk, sanctions, demand, inventories, shipping disruption.

rubric.alert: Brent > $110, or 1-month change > +30%, or a major physical supply outage (> 2 mb/d).
